svg.text: 2x boss D7 x 3, M3 4.5 deep, at CSB3 holes (D3.5, 27 x 27 diag.)
HD34-24-33PE envelope from TE CVM model (dashed)
Inside: D54 x 2.0 seat for HD34 flange D50.80 (Ra 0.8, flat 0.13); panel 4.0
4x D3.4 thru, csk D6.9 x 90 deg
Parker ORD 5700 Design Chart 4-3, W 1.78 face seal, liquids
groove R 0.13-0.38, break edges 0.13, Ra 0.8 (32 rms) groove + lid face
squeeze 26 % nominal, fill 71 %; AS568-039 stretched ~2.4 % on centreline
1. 6061-T6 billet body + lid. Stock est.: body 75 x 100 x 53, lid 75 x 75 x 8.
2. Seal: AS568-039 (same groove length 229.6 as the VRC box), compound TBD (E4).
3. Lid: 4x M3 x 12 ISO 10642 A2 countersunk, tapped holes outside the O-ring.
4. Connector on LID: TE Deutsch HD34-24-33PE, jam nut. Cutout per TE 114-151014
rev A 3.3-I (D43.08 / 41.45 flat, seal face D50.80, panel 1.59-4.76).
Flange inside on the D54 seat; lockwasher 112264 + panel nut 112263-90 outside,
7.4-8.4 N.m (114-151014 3.11). Nut D47.63 needs a 1-7/8 in socket above the lid.
Geometry behind the flange (15.7) read from TE CVM model c-hd34-24-33pe-a-3d.stp.
5. CSB3 (33 x 33 x 4.21, 2x D3.5 holes; ECUMaster manual v2.1 p.4) on 2x Keystone
25510 nylon standoffs. 26 wires (20 AWG) contact -> pads; 14 mm clear to the board.
6. Mating HD36-24-33SE plug + boot sits above the lid: keep about 70 mm clear.
7. Mount on nylon M5 hardware (E5). Break edges 0.2; no coating on seal faces.
Body + lid, O-ring face seal, HD34 jam-nut receptacle on the lid
Units mm | 3rd-angle | scales as noted | 6061-T6 | General tol. ISO 2768-m unless noted
